mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS menu_id, m.cat_id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, m.name, m.price, ma.url AS image_url, m.description, m.sold_out FROM menu m JOIN category c ON c.id = m.cat_id LEFT JOIN media_asset ma ON ma.id = m.image_asset_id AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE m.id = #{menuId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ingredient_id AS ingredientId, ing_name AS name, ing_sold_out AS isSoldOut, role, quantity, unit, is_default AS isDefault, can_remove AS canRemove FROM vw_menu_ing_json WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY CASE UPPER(role) WHEN 'CORE' THEN 1 WHEN 'BASE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, sort_no, ingredient_id

SELECT policy.option_group_id AS optionGroupId, policy.name, policy.group_type AS groupType, policy.select_type AS selectType, policy.min_select AS minSelect, policy.max_select AS maxSelect, policy.is_required AS isRequired, ( SELECT recommended_item.item_name FROM JSON_TABLE( policy.items, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( item_name VARCHAR(120) PATH '$.name', is_recommended TINYINT PATH '$.isRecommended' ) ) AS recommended_item WHERE recommended_item.is_recommended = 1 LIMIT 1 ) AS recommendedLabel FROM vw_menu_opt_policy_json policy WHERE policy.menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY policy.sort_order

SELECT serving_g AS servingG, kcal, carb_g AS carbG, sugar_g AS sugarG, protein_g AS proteinG, fat_g AS fatG, saturated_fat_g AS saturatedFatG, sodium_mg AS sodiumMg FROM menu_nutr WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT DISTINCT allergen_name FROM ( SELECT a.name AS allergen_name FROM menu_ing mi JOIN ing_allergen ia ON ia.ing_id = mi.ing_id JOIN allergen a ON a.id = ia.allergen_id WHERE mi.menu_id = #{menuId} UNION SELECT a.name AS allergen_name FROM menu_opt_policy mop JOIN opt_policy_item opi ON opi.policy_id = mop.policy_id JOIN opt_item oi ON oi.id = opi.opt_item_id JOIN ing_allergen ia ON ia.ing_id = oi.ing_id JOIN allergen a ON a.id = ia.allergen_id WHERE mop.menu_id = #{menuId} ) menu_allergens ORDER BY allergen_name
SELECT t.name FROM menu_tag mt JOIN tag t ON t.id = mt.tag_id WHERE mt.menu_id = #{menuId} AND t.active = 1 ORDER BY t.name

SELECT ml.menu_id AS menuId, ml.category_id AS categoryId, ml.name, ml.price, ml.image_url AS imageUrl, ml.is_sold_out AS isSoldOut, ml.has_sold_out_ingredient AS hasSoldOutIngredient, ml.is_orderable AS isOrderable FROM vw_menu_list ml
ORDER BY ml.price ASC
ORDER BY ml.price DESC
ORDER BY ml.name DESC
ORDER BY ml.name ASC
LIMIT #{request.size} OFFSET #{request.offset}
SELECT id AS categoryId, name AS categoryName, sort_no AS sortOrder, active AS active FROM category WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY sort_no ASC
SELECT id AS categoryId, name AS categoryName, sort_no AS sortOrder, active AS active FROM category WHERE id = #{categoryId} AND active = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id AS id, i.name AS name, i.sold_out AS isSoldOut, cc.name AS roleName, NULL AS unitName, n.serving_g AS servingG, n.kcal AS kcal, n.carb_g AS carbG, n.sugar_g AS sugarG, n.protein_g AS proteinG, n.fat_g AS fatG, n.saturated_fat_g AS saturatedFatG, n.sodium_mg AS sodiumMg FROM ing i LEFT JOIN common_code cc ON i.type_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN ing_nutr n ON n.ing_id = i.id WHERE i.id = #{ingredientId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (cat_id, name, price, image_asset_id, description, sold_out) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{mediaAssetId}, #{description}, #{soldOut} )
mapper.select: SELECT cc.id FROM common_code cc JOIN code_group cg ON cg.id = cc.code_grp_id WHERE cg.group_code = #{groupCode} AND cc.active = 1 AND ( UPPER(cc.code) = UPPER(#{code}) OR UPPER(cc.name) = UPPER(#{code}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(cc.code) = UPPER(#{code}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id FROM tag t WHERE t.active = 1 AND ( ( #{code} IS NOT NULL AND #{code} != '' AND UPPER(t.code) = UPPER(#{code}) ) OR ( #{name} IS NOT NULL AND #{name} != '' AND t.name = #{name} ) ) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM media_asset WHERE id = #{mediaAssetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM media_asset WHERE url = #{url} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id AS id, i.name AS name, i.sold_out AS isSoldOut, cc.name AS roleName, NULL AS unitName, n.serving_g AS servingG, n.kcal AS kcal, n.carb_g AS carbG, n.sugar_g AS sugarG, n.protein_g AS proteinG, n.fat_g AS fatG, n.saturated_fat_g AS saturatedFatG, n.sodium_mg AS sodiumMg FROM ing i LEFT JOIN common_code cc ON i.type_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN ing_nutr n ON n.ing_id = i.id ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_ing ( menu_id, ing_id, role_id, quantity, unit_id, is_default, can_remove, sort_no ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{ingredientId}, #{roleId}, #{quantity}, #{unitId}, #{isDefault}, #{canRemove}, #{sortNo} )
INSERT INTO menu_nutr ( menu_id, kcal, carb_g, protein_g, fat_g, sodium_mg ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{kcal}, #{carbG}, #{proteinG}, #{fatG}, #{sodiumMg} )
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{menuId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
